observations: Photo 0 shows an industrial plastic bottle making machine in a workshop setting.
A tall metal frame with control panel/label area is visible; there are blue side panels and a front access door.

identity.kind: automatic plastic bottle making machine (PET bottle making)

claims.claim: Automatic Plastic Bottle Making Machine used in production to make pet plastic bottles of different...
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photo 0 does not show readable specs or proof of PET bottle output or bottle size range.

risks.risk: Machine type is unclear (e.g., preform injection + stretch blow vs. other PET process). Different types have very different value and required accessories.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing the full production cycle and the exact bottle type produced (PET preform/blow process) plus a close-up of the process section labels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic PET bottle making machine with unknown process and unknown completeness (worst case: missing key parts/accessories).

risks.risk: Missing molds/dies and bottle-size tooling (often the main cost). Photo 0 does not show any mold/die set.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of all molds/dies/tooling included, with part numbers/labels, and a photo of the machine’s mold mounting area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as machine only, with tooling not guaranteed (worst case: no molds/dies included).

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown (no power-on test, no running video, no output demonstration).
risks.proof: Ask for a video of the machine powering on and running through at least one cycle, showing stable operation and finished bottles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: needs repair/untested).

risks.risk: Capacity/specs (bottles per hour, bottle sizes, voltage/phase) are not readable; these determine price.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the nameplate/spec plate (model, voltage, power, capacity) and the control panel settings screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest end for an unverified, unspecified-capacity machine.

risks.risk: Shipping/installation readiness (crating, dimensions, weight, required utilities) is unknown.
risks.proof: Ask for measurements (L×W×H), weight, and required utilities (power/air) shown on the nameplate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as difficult-to-ship/needs setup (worst case: buyer bears installation/utility requirements).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the machine nameplate/spec plate (brand/model, serial number, voltage/phase, capacity).
Video of the machine running and producing PET bottles (show finished bottles and the size range).
Photos of all included molds/dies/tooling (with any part numbers/labels).
Video showing the full process section relevant to PET bottle making (so we confirm the exact machine type).
Measurements and weight + required utilities (power/air) from the spec plate.
response.reason: The photo confirms an industrial plastic/PET bottle making machine exists, but the exact model/type, included tooling, and working condition are not verifiable from the single image. Without those, a safe worst-case price cannot be selected.
